proposals.evidence: Turner pattrala, sense 2 thin, explicitly gives Assamese/Bengali pātal and Bengali pātlā. The Hajong and Bishnupriya survey uses shift thin/slender to light in weight; the local a/o and syncope variants fit this eastern family. The adjective is not assigned to an unrelated patra leaf node.
